Labron supports ready mobility plus probable cause and no separate exigency: the lake issue frames separate exigency beyond ready mobility and probable cause, and the rule says no separate exigency is required.
Ross supports object-limited vehicle/container scope: the star-verified quote says scope is defined by the object of the search and places where there is probable cause to believe it may be found.
The black-letter rule has at least two affirmative supporting authorities in the disclosed lake records: Carroll/Labron for the warrant/exigency elements and Ross for scope.
